D/ [CONSTANS] PF AVG ; R/ VICTOR[IAE DD AVG Q NN]

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus probably of Constans dating AD347-348. Reece period 17. Reverse: VICTORIAE DD AVG Q NN. Obverse: Diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANS] PF AVG. Reverse: Two victories facing each other, each with wreath. Reverse inscription: VICTOR[IAE DD AVG Q NN]. Die axis measurement: 12.00. Dimensions: diameter: 14.42mm; weight: 1.48g
